subject.title: Prompt Optimisation Plugins: Context Engine as the Integration Point for Message-Level Optimisation

question: Should OpenClaw treat this as external prompt-optimisation plugin guidance, or sponsor a narrowly scoped public context-engine contract/documentation improvement for the lifecycle gaps identified after source verification?
rationale: The issue proposes an architecture and a potential ecosystem capability rather than reporting a broken established behavior; deciding whether core should document or extend the plugin seam requires maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Validate and route externally
options.body: Confirm that the existing context-engine API supports the described message optimisation lifecycle, then close this as ClawHub guidance for an external plugin.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow API/docs gap
options.body: Keep this issue open only for a specifically verified missing lifecycle capability, with the implementation limited to the public plugin contract or its documentation.

recommendation.title: Validate and route externally
recommendation.body: Confirm that the existing context-engine API supports the described message optimisation lifecycle, then close this as ClawHub guidance for an external plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent context-engine history is the strongest available routing signal, although direct blame and log review are still required.
